record.t: Was elected minority leader by Assembly Republicans after a vote to remove Heath Flora from the post.
record.q: Assembly Republicans elected Macedo, a first-term Tulare lawmaker, as their new minority leader after a vote to get Flora to vacate the leadership position.

record.q: Macedo also unveiled a new leadership team that includes Assemblyman David Tangipa of Fresno as minority whip and Assemblyman Josh Hoover of Folsom as minority floor leader.
